name: Wörth am Rhein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged at the top with the city arms of Wörth am Rhein (a yellow figure on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Wörth am Rhein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wörth am Rhein arms — yellow figure on blue
